# Lekhan monospace test vectors (docs/LEKHAN.md). CC0 / public domain.
#
# One per line: the text with its clusters split by "|", a tab, each
# cluster's cells, a tab, a note. Joiners are written as <ZWJ> and <ZWNJ>, any other
# character as <U+XXXX>.
# A conforming implementation finds these clusters and these cells; a
# conforming font shapes each line's text exactly (sum of cells) x its
# cell wide.
#
## One cell: a consonant or a vowel with its signs.
क	1	ka
का	1	ka + aa sign
कि	1	ka + i sign (drawn before it)
की	1	ka + ii sign
कु	1	ka + u sign
कू	1	ka + uu sign
कृ	1	ka + vocalic r sign
के	1	ka + e sign
कै	1	ka + ai sign
को	1	ka + o sign
कौ	1	ka + au sign
कं	1	ka + anusvara
कँ	1	ka + candrabindu
कः	1	ka + visarga (a spacing sign)
कॉ	1	ka + candra o (Marathi, English loans)
क़	1	qa, ka + nukta
क़ि	1	qa (U+0958) + i sign
ड़ी	1	rra + ii sign
दुः	1	da + u sign + visarga
हु	1	ha + u sign
माँ	1	ma + aa sign + candrabindu
न|हीं	1 1	na, ha + ii sign + anusvara
आ	1	independent aa
ई	1	independent ii
ऋ	1	vocalic r
औ	1	independent au
ॲ	1	Marathi candra a
ॐ	1	om
ऽ	1	avagraha
।	1	danda
॥	1	double danda
०	1	digit zero
क्	1	ka + virama, no consonant after it: one cell
न्	1	the final n of shrimaan
ह्	1	ha + virama
## Two cells: two or more consonants joined by the virama (a conjunct).
क्ष	2	ksha, one ligature in most fonts
ज्ञ	2	jnya
त्र	2	tra
त्न	2	half ta + na
श्र	2	shra
द्ध	2	ddha
द्व	2	dva
प्र	2	pa + rakar
क्र	2	ka + rakar
र्य	2	reph + ya
र्क	2	reph + ka
ट्ट	2	tta + virama + tta (stacked or with a visible virama)
ड्ड	2	dda + virama + dda
ङ्क	2	nga + virama + ka
ह्म	2	ha + virama + ma
स्क	2	half sa + ka
क्षि	2	ksha + i sign
र्कि	2	reph + ka + i sign
र्की	2	reph + ka + ii sign
श्री	2	shra + ii sign
द्या	2	dya + aa sign
स्क्री	2	three consonants: half sa, ka, rakar, ii sign
स्त्र	2	three consonants
क्ष्म	2	three consonants: ksha + ma
द्द्व	2	three consonants (Sanskrit)
न्त्र्य	2	four consonants
स्क्रीं	2	three consonants, ii sign, anusvara
क्<ZWJ>ष	2	half ka asked for with a joiner: still one cluster
र्<ZWJ>य	2	eyelash ra (Marathi)
ऱ्य	2	rra + virama + ya (Marathi eyelash ra)
## Words: the clusters one after another.
क्<ZWNJ>|ष	1 1	a non-joiner after the virama ends the cluster: ka + virama, ssa
हि|न्दी	1 2	hindi
श्री|मा|न्	2 1 1	shriimaan
क्ष|त्रि|य	2 2 1	kshatriya
सं|स्कृ|त	1 2 1	sanskrit
वि|द्या|र्थी	1 2 2	vidyaarthii
ब|हा|उ|ल्ला|ह	1 1 1 2 1	bahaaullaah
प्रा|र्थ|ना	2 2 1	praarthanaa
रा|ष्ट्र	1 2	raashtra
अ|र्थ	1 2	artha
ज़ि|न्द|गी	1 2 1	zindagii
आ|त्मा	1 2	aatmaa
उ|द्दे|श्य	1 2 2	uddeshya
## Marks without a letter are drawn on a dotted circle: one cell.
ा	1	aa sign alone
ं	1	anusvara alone
## Other scripts keep their own widths.
A	1	Latin
e<U+0301>	1	e + combining acute
日	2	East Asian wide
